name: The Office Experiment
desc:
Start your first day at the vintage mens clothing company. Make sure to follow all instructions of upper management!

🔥🔥🔥 COMPANY PROTOCOL UPDATE 🔥🔥🔥
😱 Limited ammo round
🎂 Derek's birthday (insane loot, and jazz)
🏛️ Classic (old rounds)
💥 Violence (only final round)


CONTROLS (PC):
Q - block
F - kick
C - crouch
R - reload
HOLD R - check ammo
RIGHT CLICK - aim/ throw 
X - drop item
SHIFT - sprint
LEFT CLICK - punch/use/disarm

Please thumbs up the game to see more updates 👍👍👍👍👍👍👍
